Article 5 (Activities of Judges Outside Their Official Duties)
(1) Judges may engage in activities outside their official duties, including participation in academic activities or membership in religious or cultural organizations, only where such activities do not impair their dignity or interfere with the performance of their duties.
(2) Judges shall not become involved in the legal disputes of others or engage in conduct that influences the adjudication of another judge.
(3) Where there is a risk of influencing a trial or giving rise to doubts about impartiality, judges shall not provide legal advice or information about attorneys or other legal professionals.
